item.title: github: Usage metrics API flags telemetry and version gaps
item.description:
The Copilot usage metrics API now identifies users who are missing client telemetry or are using IDE/extension versions below the usage metrics minimums. It adds new per-user fields to expose these gaps.

  • Source: GitHub
